description: Branch R-FMT-2 Generated values (counter consumption) on an ACCDB. Au(ID AutoNumber primary key, U Long unique, S Text) with three rows. One variable at a time, @@IDENTITY read after each: (a) a recordset AddNew with the ID read before any put, then CancelUpdate, then an insert; (b) an INSERT refused for a duplicate U (dbFailOnError), then an insert; (c) a recordset AddNew whose Update is refused for a duplicate U, then the same row's U changed and Update repeated, with the ID read before and after; (d) Workspaces(0).BeginTrans, an insert, Rollback, then an insert; (e) an insert with an explicit existing ID (refused), then an insert. Asks when the next value is taken and whether cancel, refusal and rollback consume it.
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
